# Handoff brief — Orient to the request (Harbor Relay specification review)
## Work item
- **Title:** Orient to the request
- **Owner:** Alex Morgan
- **Status:** Open
## Ask
Review the support-access conflict, state the conditions needed for the pilot, and return your findings on this work item.
## Current basis
- **Sam Patel reports** that support can open a report only for a customer support ticket, and every access is logged (reported, not independently verified).
- **Specification v1** states support staff cannot open report content.
- **Retention** (30 days) is still unconfirmed.
- The saved reassessment of the support-access fact is in the same matter conversation.
## What to review
1. **The support-access conflict.** The supplied spec (v1) says support cannot open report content; Sam Patel reports ticket-only support access with logging. These conflict as reported. Determine which reflects the intended access model, or whether the spec needs updating to describe conditional support access.
2. **Conditions needed for the pilot.** Identify what must be true or documented before launch (21 Oct 2026) — e.g., an accurate access statement, defined support-access conditions, logging/auditability, and confirmation of the 30-day retention.
3. **Return findings** on this work item.
## Open items to confirm
- Whether support access is ticket-only (per Sam Patel) or prohibited (per spec v1).
- Whether the 30-day retention is confirmed and deliberate.
- Whether the "only the customer can open" access statement needs reconciling with any support access.
## Constraints
- Draft only — do not create or accept a handoff.
- Do not change ownership, facts, decisions, or work products.
- No legal decision recorded; no draft created.
---
